selection_rule: highest validation ROC-AUC; if a more interpretable candidate is within 0.005 AUC, choose it. Fairness gate applied separately.
fairness_gate: Validation-date check (UK vs Non-UK): disparate impact ratio in [0.80,1.25]; TPR and FPR within +/-10% of overall. Selected model passed (see validation fairness output); no mitigation triggered.
